headline: Gannon keep winning and keep the goals out
dek: Gannon have won six matches, drawn one and lost one, and have conceded nine goals all season while scoring twenty-four. Both of their conference matches have been won at home, and they are not at home again until Seton Hill visit.
displaced_by: Gannon's nine-goal home win over Pitt-Johnstown on 2026-09-26; the standing dek's E. Stroudsburg figures (fifteen scored, fifteen conceded) are no longer true

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Millersville have scored more than Lock Haven, Pitt-Johnstown and West Chester together, and seven different players have scored for them: the spread of scorers, not one name, is what the chart is drawing.

wire.line: Gannon have conceded nine goals all season and lost once, at home to Lake Erie on opening night.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: E. Stroudsburg lead the table without a conference defeat, and all three of their losses came before conference play opened; across the season they have won six, drawn two and lost three.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown have conceded 26 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and have won one match, drawn one and lost five.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rafael Santos has four goals and seven assists from 25 shots for Seton Hill.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jaden Howard has made 30 saves for West Chester and been beaten five times.

last_match.line: Gannon arrived on a run of three straight wins; Pitt-Johnstown had not won since their opening match at Chestnut Hill.

next_match.line: Only three players have scored for West Chester this season; Shepherd have not lost since Millersville visited on the opening day of conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
